{"metadata":{"description":"一个Deepseek Harness插件，可以为每一个工作区配置独立的Api Key","id":"gh:1409132962","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-workspace-api-key","slug":"COH2357/dsh-workspace-api-key","topics":["deepseek-harness","deepseek-harness-plugin","dsh","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"一个Deepseek Harness插件，可以为每一个工作区配置独立的Api Key"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-workspace-api-key"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness plugin that binds a separate DeepSeek API key to each workspace — or to a single "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ek Harness plugin that binds a separate DeepSeek API key to each workspace — or to a single session."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"DSH resolves the DeepSeek key from one global credential ref (default `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`), so every "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"session in every workspace spends the same key. This plugin adds a panel that gives individual works"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"paces — and, when you need it, individual sessions — their own key, so the spend of a key stays with"},{"id":"p5s4","text":" the sessions that ran there. Anything without its own key keeps using the level above it:"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## What you get"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **A sidebar row** labelled `API Key 分配`, placed directly under the host's own Plugins row, opening"},{"id":"p8s2","text":" a full-area page.
- **Per-workspace keys** — every workspace registered with the `workspaceRegistry"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"` service is listed, with its own key field.
- **Per-session keys** — each workspace row expands (co"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"llapsed by default) to the sessions that live in that directory, each with its own key. Sessions tha"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"t inherit a key from the level above say so instead of pretending to have one.
- **A system-default "},{"id":"p8s6","text":"card** — which ref is in effect, where its value comes from (`file`, `env`, …), and its masked value"},{"id":"p8s7","text":".
- **Connection test** — one real `POST <baseURL>/messages` request (`max_tokens: 1`) with that key"},{"id":"p8s8","text":", reported as `ok`, `invalid`, `quota`, `rate-limit` or `unreachable`. A successful test also clears"},{"id":"p8s9","text":" a stale flag.
- **Stale-key warning** — 401/403 marks a bound key `invalid`, 402 marks it `quota`, "},{"id":"p8s10","text":"429 marks it `rate-limit`. When you enter a session whose effective key is flagged, an overlay tells"},{"id":"p8s11","text":" you what happened and offers *go configure*, *fall back to the level above*, or dismiss.
- **Mismat"},{"id":"p8s12","text":"ch warning** — if the key you bound was recorded for one provider (say `deepseek-official`) and the "},{"id":"p8s13","text":"session now runs on another, entering that session reports it, because that request would be sent wi"},{"id":"p8s14","text":"th a key the provider does not accept.
- **No silent substitution** — neither warning ever changes w"},{"id":"p8s15","text":"hich key is used. The decision stays with you, which is the whole point: an automatically swapped ke"},{"id":"p8s16","text":"y would defeat the billing separation.
- **One-click revert** — clearing a session entry falls back "},{"id":"p8s17","text":"to the workspace key, clearing a workspace entry falls back to the system default.
- **A search defa"},{"id":"p8s18","text":"ult key of its own** — the `搜索默认 key` card binds a key to `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY_SEARCH`, so search can b"},{"id":"p8s19","text":"e billed apart from chat: a session's own key wins, then a synced workspace's chat cascade, then thi"},{"id":"p8s20","text":"s key, then whatever the official search page stores.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Host half (`lib/index.js`):"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"- wraps `credentials.resolve` once per process (restored on dispose through `ctx.effect`) instead of"},{"id":"p11s2","text":" registering a second service or provider route, neither of which cordis allows for a name that is a"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"lready taken;
- reads the active session's directory and id from `agents.currentInitiator()?.session"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"` — the agent loop runs the whole turn inside that async scope, so both are available when the crede"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"ntial is resolved, and the resolver picks the most specific level that has a key;
- matches that dir"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"ectory against `workspaceRegistry.list()` after normalizing both sides (absolute, trailing separator"},{"id":"p11s7","text":" removed, lower-cased on Windows);
- derives a stable ref per level — `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY_WS_<first 16"},{"id":"p11s8","text":" hex chars of sha1(normalized path), upper-cased>` for a workspace and `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY_SS_<first 1"},{"id":"p11s9","text":"6 hex chars of sha1(session id), upper-cased>` for a session (a session id contains `-` and cannot b"},{"id":"p11s10","text":"e a ref name) — writes the key through the credentials service, and serves that ref's value;
- rewri"},{"id":"p11s11","text":"tes only refs a provider actually reads: the default ref, every adapter's configured `apiKeyEnv`, an"},{"id":"p11s12","text":"d its own generated refs. Every other ref passes through untouched;
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### HTTP API (loopback only)"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| Method | Path | Purpose |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"| GET | `/wsk-api/state` | default ref status, workspaces with their sessions, overrides, invalid fl"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"ags, plugin version and session probe |
| GET | `/wsk-api/resolve` | which level and ref the current"},{"id":"p14s3","text":" session resolves to right now |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Requirements and limits"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- Verified against DSH Desktop 2.0.17 with `@deepseek-ai/dsh*` 0.2.0-rc.2 and `@deepseek-ai/cordis` "},{"id":"p16s2","text":"4.0.4. It has no runtime dependency and imports no `@deepseek-ai/*` package — only the host services"},{"id":"p16s3","text":" (`credentials`, `workspaceRegistry`, `agents`, `sessionController`, `webServer`, `llm`, `settings`)"},{"id":"p16s4","text":" and Node built-ins.
- One key per level: a session has a single key whichever provider route reads "},{"id":"p16s5","text":"it, and a key recorded for one provider is reported as a mismatch when the session runs on another. "},{"id":"p16s6","text":"Model changes inside one provider are not treated as a mismatch, because a DeepSeek key is account-w"},{"id":"p16s7","text":"ide.
- Sessions are matched to a workspace by their directory (`cwd`). The host's own `list()` skips"},{"id":"p16s8","text":" stored sessions that never got a `cwd`, and the live-session fallback only knows sessions that are "},{"id":"p16s9","text":"currently loaded, so the panel may show fewer sessions than the sidebar. Sessions visible only in th"},{"id":"p16s10","text":"e browser-side store carry no `cwd` of their own beyond the one the sidebar knows.
- The connection "},{"id":"p16s11","text":"test speaks the Anthropic Messages shape (`POST <baseURL>/messages` with `x-api-key` and `anthropic-"},{"id":"p16s12","text":"version: 2023-06-01`), which is what the DeepSeek route uses. A provider that speaks a different pro"},{"id":"p16s13","text":"tocol can still have keys bound per level, but the test may report a failure for a key that works.
-"},{"id":"p16s14","text":" Search support needs a DSH build that ships the official Search/Fetch API (`web-deepseek-api`, the "},{"id":"p16s15","text":"设置 → 插件 → 网页搜索 page with `启用新版 Web 搜索 API`). On a build without it the plugin simply never sees a se"},{"id":"p16s16","text":"arch request: the switch stays visible, and the panel reports the legacy Messages channel instead of"},{"id":"p16s17","text":" guessing.
- Keys are stored through the credentials service in `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` under "},{"id":"p16s18","text":"`refs:`, in plaintext, exactly like the default key. They are not written into session logs, the plu"},{"id":"p16s19","text":"gin's state file, or the plugin directory.
- Matching is textual after normalization. If a session's"},{"id":"p16s20","text":" `cwd` is a symlink or junction to a registered workspace path, it will not match and the level abov"},{"id":"p16s21","text":" or junction to a registered workspace path, it will not match and the level above is used.
